Create a FastAPI application in a file named app.py. Include necessary imports. Define a POST endpoint at path '/health' that returns a JSON response {"status": "healthy"}. No request body is required. Include a conditional block to run the app with uvicorn when the script is executed directly. Ensure the endpoint returns a proper FastAPI Response model (Pydantic BaseModel optional). No database or external dependencies beyond FastAPI and uvicorn.
